description: This file defines the 'Returns' controller class for handling email notifications related to product returns within the OpenCart admin module. It extends the base system controller and includes a method to send return-related emails, including fetching return, order, and store information, and configuring email parameters.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class responsible for sending email notifications about product returns to customers. It loads necessary models and language files, retrieves return and order data, constructs email content, and sends emails.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to handle the email process for a return. It fetches return, order, store, and language info based on parameters, constructs the email subject and content, and sends the email if notifications are enabled.
